summary: New Era Energy & Digital filed an 8-K disclosing a pending settlement agreement with the U.S. Trustee for bankruptcy estates of Acacia Resources and Acacia Operating Company. The company will pay $1.0 million to resolve all claims by New Mexico, with dismissal with prejudice upon Bankruptcy Court approval. No admission of liability. The CEO faces separate individual claims. The settlement is contingent on court approval, with no specific timeline or advisor named. Watch for Bankruptcy Court hearing and potential impact on environmental liabilities.
